change: Fuse convolution-history commit into the retained 256-GRF ESIMD state replay; one kernel instead of two per GDN layer.
baseline: Previously retained ESIMD state replay plus the separate existing history-commit kernel. No pre-ESIMD baseline.
dispatch: ACM G10, four/six-token capacity, valid GDN dimensions and non-null device acceptance counter; callers keep the existing fallback elsewhere.
measurement_scope: Operator stage only: host submission through queue completion per 36 independent GDN layers, with separate saved input buffers per layer. No new steady-state whole-model decode/prefill measurements; percentages are not additive to earlier rounds.

calibrated_confirmation.method: Three fresh processes; in each, every timed shape runs A/B/A/B/A using the same kernel object and benchmark. A explicitly calls the existing two-kernel route; B calls the fused route. Each phase resets inputs/state, checks full state/history/output, warms up 64 sequences, then retains nine batches of 32 sequences with one queue completion per batch. For each process take median of its three A and two B phase medians, then take medians across processes. Neighbor gains use the geometric mean of bracketing A phases.

earlier_process_screen.method: Five fresh A/B/A/B/A processes; same common benchmark object, 64 warmup sequences and 31 retained batches of 32 per shape.
earlier_process_screen.use: Supporting screen only: some neighboring baseline drift exceeded 3%; final table uses within-shape calibration.

simpler_alternative.change: Remove only the unused root-sync property from the separate convolution-history kernel.
simpler_alternative.reason: Small and inconsistent observations; does not explain or replace the fusion gain.
simpler_alternative.method: Three fresh A/B/A processes, same common benchmark object, 16 warmups and nine retained batches of eight per shape.

correctness.coverage: Capacities 1 through 8, zero through full acceptance; bitwise recurrence state parity, independent CPU history oracle, history buffer canaries and untouched output; null acceptance counter declines fusion.

integrated_model_validation.scope: Four cold correctness requests; not steady-state performance measurements.
